description: Floors for the New Job 03/09 plan benchmark (scripts/benchmark-plan-geometry.mjs, estimator's hand trace as reference, 300 mm wall tolerance, 700 mm opening tolerance). A geometry change may improve on these but must not fall below them; update only with a reviewed reason. Rooms counts every returned room record (wholes and their parts). Bedroom 3's reference polygon includes its robe, which the engine returns as a separate room, hence its wider area limit. Ground Floor room references were traced from the sheet on 2026-10-13; the Laundry limit records a known error (its tub bench is read as wall), not an acceptable result.
